name: Ilmatar
role: Air maiden who drifts on the primeval sea and gives shape to the world
fun_fact: In some folk poems she is called Ilman impi, the air maiden, and she is the mother of Väinämöinen as well as of the world.

name: Väinämöinen
role: Ancient singer and culture hero who orders the world by song
fun_fact: He is born already old, and in one rune he plays a kantele made from a pike's jaw so well that the whole forest weeps.

name: Ilmarinen
role: Eternal smith who forges the Sampo
fun_fact: His epithet is 'the eternal smith', and some folk poems give him a hand in forging the vault of the sky.

name: Louhi
role: Mistress of Pohjola and keeper of the Sampo
fun_fact: In the Kalevala she hides the sun and the moon inside a mountain, and the heroes must go north to get them back.

name: Lemminkäinen
role: Reckless adventurer who dies at the river of the dead
fun_fact: He is also called Kaukomieli, 'the far-minded one', a name that sits oddly on such a reckless man.

name: Tuoni
role: Ruler of the land of the dead
fun_fact: His realm is separated from the living by a river, and the swan that swims there is the bird Lemminkäinen was told to kill.

name: Mielikki
role: Forest goddess who cares for the animals and grants healing
fun_fact: Hunters asked her leave before entering the forest, and charms credit her with healing wounds as well as with giving game.

name: Beaivi
role: Sámi sun goddess, addressed as mother of the people
fun_fact: Beaivi is often shown with her daughter Beaivi-nieida, and the two are linked with the return of light after the polar night.

name: Máttaráhkká
role: Sámi earth mother and ancestress of the goddesses
fun_fact: Her name is usually translated as 'earth mother' or 'ancestral mother', and she is the mother of the three goddesses who attend birth.

name: Noaidi
role: Sámi ritual specialist who travels to other worlds
fun_fact: The noaidi's drum was a map of the cosmos as well as an instrument, which is one reason the mission wanted it destroyed.
